_comment: The visitor identity token a tenant's site signs and the widget passes to POST /api/v1/webchat/sessions as `identityToken` (level 2, design D4-D7). Format: a compact JWS (JWT) `base64url(header).base64url(payload).base64url(signature)`, HMAC-SHA256 over the ASCII bytes of `base64url(header).base64url(payload)`, keyed with the UTF-8 bytes of the tenant's WebChat credential `identityTokenSecret` (fixtures/webchat-identity-secret-admin.v1.json). JWT was chosen over the CSAT `v1.{payload}.{sig}` format so a Partner's site signs with any JWT library (design D4). The secrets below are FIXTURE VALUES ONLY: they exist so tests can recompute every signature byte for byte; they are not, and must never become, a real tenant's secret. The token is never logged, stored or echoed by the Platform; only its refusal code is logged with the tenant (design D7). There is no replay cache in the first cut: a token can be presented again until its `exp`, which is why its lifetime is capped at 3600 s (design D6). Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names and codes VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

headerRules.alg: required, exactly "HS256"; any other value ("none", "HS512", "RS256", absent) answers identity-token-malformed before any signature is computed
headerRules.typ: optional; when present it MUST be "JWT"
headerRules.kid: optional and ignored: the verifier tries the current secret, then the previous one inside its grace window (design D8), so a site needs no key id

claims.external_id: string, REQUIRED, 1..256 characters after trimming: the site's own stable id of its logged-in customer. It is the level-2 key: the contact is resolved by the WebChat address `webchat-external:<external_id>` (fixtures/contact-identity-level.v1.json). The site SHOULD use an opaque id, never an e-mail or a national id: it is stored and shown to agents in the contact's addresses
claims.aud: string or array, REQUIRED: the Verbara tenant id the token is for. Either a string equal to the request's `tenantId`, or a non-empty JSON array of strings every member of which equals the request's `tenantId` (a JWT library that always writes `aud` as an array is accepted). An array holding any other member is refused with identity-token-wrong-tenant; an empty array, a non-string member or any other type is identity-token-malformed (boundary-matrix H1, review fix, 2026-11-04)
claims.iat: integer Unix seconds, REQUIRED: when the site signed the token
claims.exp: integer Unix seconds, REQUIRED: exp > iat and exp - iat <= 3600
claims.name: string, optional, at most 200 characters: the customer's display name; fills the contact's first name only when the contact has no name, exactly as the inbound resolver does today
claims.email: string, optional, at most 320 characters: stored as the contact custom field `webchatEmail`; it NEVER becomes an Email channel address and never links contacts (design D3)

clock.rules: refused when iat > now + 300 (identity-token-not-yet-valid) or now > exp + 300 (identity-token-expired); the 5-minute skew is the CsatWebChatTokenVerifier precedent

testVector._note: now = 2026-11-04T14:05:00Z (Unix 1793801100). tenantId of the request = t-demo-0001. The tenant's current identityTokenSecret is `currentSecret`; `previousSecret` was replaced at 2026-11-04T09:00:00Z, so it is inside its 24 h grace (design D8). `previousSecret` is tried only when `identityTokenSecretReplacedAt` parses as an ISO 8601 instant: a previous secret with a missing or unparseable stamp is never tried (fail closed; review P2, 2026-11-04).

accepted.case: signed with the current secret, inside its lifetime
signed with the previous secret, inside the 24 h grace after rotation
signed with the current secret, `aud` given as a one-member JSON array ["t-demo-0001"] (boundary-matrix H1)

refused.case: the tenant has no identityTokenSecret configured
not three segments, not base64url, or longer than 4096 characters
signed with another tenant's secret (bad signature)
validly signed for another tenant (aud t-other-0002, request tenantId t-demo-0001)
validly signed, `aud` an array holding the request tenant and another tenant ["t-demo-0001","t-other-0002"]
validly signed, `aud` an empty JSON array []
validly signed, exp - iat = 86400 (over the 3600 s cap)
validly signed, exp 2026-11-04T13:00:00Z (more than 300 s before now)
signed with the previous secret after its 24 h grace ended, or after an admin removed identityTokenSecretPrevious
refused.token: (the valid_previous token above, presented at 2026-11-05T09:00:01Z or later)

refused.case: signed with the previous secret inside 24 h of the rotation, but the stored identityTokenSecretReplacedAt is missing or does not parse as an ISO 8601 instant: the previous secret is never tried (fail closed)
refused.token: (the valid_previous token above, presented at 2026-11-04T14:05:00Z with identityTokenSecretReplacedAt absent or "not-a-date")

evaluationOrder: 1. no identityTokenSecret for the tenant -> identity-token-not-configured
2. structure, length <= 4096, base64url, header JSON, alg == HS256 -> else identity-token-malformed

3. HMAC-SHA256 with the current secret, then the previous secret only while identityTokenSecretReplacedAt parses and now < it + 24 h, compared in constant time -> else identity-token-signature-invalid
4. payload JSON, external_id / aud / iat / exp present and well typed (aud a string, or a non-empty array of strings), lengths within bounds -> else identity-token-malformed
5. aud == request tenantId (a string), or every member of the aud array == request tenantId -> else identity-token-wrong-tenant
6. exp > iat and exp - iat <= 3600 -> else identity-token-lifetime-too-long
replay: No refusal code. A token is a bearer assertion valid until exp + 300 s; it is not single-use (two tabs or a reload present it again). Bounded by maxLifetimeSeconds; a jti replay cache is recorded as what would change it (design D6).
